title: How Offline Notes Sync
sourceTitle: An original tech explainer; it describes a demo design and claims no shipping product.

scenes.title: The Problem
scenes.narration: Your phone and laptop went offline. Then both edited the same note. Back online, which version should stay?
scenes.sourceQuote: Your phone and laptop went offline. Then both edited the same note. Back online, which version should stay?

props.title: Two edits: how do they merge?
props.subtitle: Offline editing and sync

scenes.title: Log the Edits First
scenes.narration: This demo design saves edits locally first. Each edit is marked with its order. Back online, devices swap missing records.
scenes.sourceQuote: This demo design saves edits locally first. Each edit is marked with its order. Back online, devices swap missing records.

scenes.title: Handling Conflicts
scenes.narration: Edits to different paragraphs can be merged. If both changed the same sentence, keep both and ask someone to confirm.
scenes.sourceQuote: Edits to different paragraphs can be merged. If both changed the same sentence, keep both and ask someone to confirm.

scenes.title: Limits
scenes.narration: Order marks can spot a conflict, but they can't tell which edit is right. Then test that nothing is lost or duplicated.
scenes.sourceQuote: Order marks can spot a conflict, but they can't tell which edit is right. Then test that nothing is lost or duplicated.
